project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to be a student management system, likely focused on exam processing, user profiles, and potentially fee management. The file structure suggests a component-based architecture, with several Vue files defining distinct UI elements and interactions. The project leverages routing to navigate between different screens and functionalities. There is a significant number of files, indicating a potentially complex application with numerous features.

layers.description: Handles the user interface and user interactions, driven by Vue.js.
Likely contains utility functions, API integrations, and potentially data processing routines.

macro_trends.title: High Prop Drilling and Route Dependency
macro_trends.description: Numerous files (e.g., ApplicationServices, ResultPage) heavily rely on router navigation via `Router push`. This creates tight coupling and could impact maintainability and performance. Furthermore, the prop drilling for `ApplicationServices` to other files suggests a need for a more structured state management solution.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission & Result Processing
key_workflows.description: The workflow starts with the user submitting an exam form (`ExamFormSubmission.vue`), potentially interacts with `ApplicationServices` to validate and process data, and ultimately displays the results in `ResultPage.vue`.  This process is heavily routed and tightly coupled, which could create bottlenecks.
